cards.answer: Zoe is an AP mage who sets up damaging star shots with sleep. Her star deals magic damage that increases with travel distance.
cards.counterplay: Dodge her bubble and redirected star; watch for attacks from across terrain.

citations.quote: Name: Zoe. Official role tags: Mage.
Maximum Magic Damage:5 – 145 (based on level) (+ 125 / 200 / 275 / 350 / 425) (+ 150% AP)
Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep.
The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.
Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight. Deals more damage the longer it flies in a straight line.

facts.claim: sets up damaging star shots with sleep

citations.quote: Active: Zoe shoots a star in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies hit based on the distance travelled.

facts.claim: Her star deals magic damage that increases with travel distance.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing the sleep into star pattern is central to avoiding her burst.

cards.answer: After casting an ability, Zoe's next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt deals bonus magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Respect her follow-up attacks after she casts.

citations.quote: Innate: After casting an ability, Zoe's next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt within a few seconds will deal bonus magic damage.

facts.claim: After casting an ability, Zoe's next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt deals bonus magic damage.

cards.priority_reason: Explains the extra damage in her spell and attack trades.

cards.answer: Zoe fires a star and can redirect it in flight. It explodes on enemy contact, dealing magic damage nearby; longer travel after redirection increases its damage.
cards.counterplay: Adjust your movement for the redirect and avoid standing close to its impact.

citations.quote: Zoe fires a missile that she can redirect in flight.
Active: Zoe shoots a star in the target direction

facts.claim: Zoe fires a star and can redirect it in flight.

citations.quote: Active: Zoe shoots a star in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies hit.

facts.claim: It explodes on enemy contact, dealing magic damage nearby

citations.quote: its total damage is increased by 0% – 150% (based on distance traveled), excluding the distance traveled by the initial cast.

facts.claim: longer travel after redirection increases its damage.

cards.priority_reason: Her main damaging projectile changes direction and rewards long travel.

cards.answer: Zoe collects dropped Spell Shards to copy eligible enemy summoner spells or item actives; shards can also come from minions. Casting Spell Thief or a summoner spell grants movement speed and orbiting bolts that deal magic damage.
cards.counterplay: Account for copied spells and avoid chasing carelessly while her movement speed and bolts are active.

citations.quote: Passive: Whenever an enemy champion casts a specific summoner spell or item active, regardless of distance, they drop the corresponding Spell Shard onto the ground
Zoe can collect a Spell Shard by moving directly onto it
Active: Zoe mimics the active effect of the collected Spell Shard.

facts.claim: Zoe collects dropped Spell Shards to copy eligible enemy summoner spells or item actives

citations.quote: Enemy minions have a chance to spawn with random Spell Shards that drop if Zoe kills them.

facts.claim: shards can also come from minions.

citations.quote: Passive - Wheeeee: Whenever Zoe casts Spell Thief or a summoner spell, she gains bonus movement speed for a short time. She also conjures 3 orbiting bolts for a period that will each shoot to the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage.

facts.claim: Casting Spell Thief or a summoner spell grants movement speed and orbiting bolts that deal magic damage.

cards.priority_reason: Copied spells and movement speed can unexpectedly extend her fighting options.

cards.answer: Zoe's bubble hits an enemy or lingers as a contact trap if it misses, and passing through terrain extends its range. It deals magic damage and applies a growing slow followed by sleep, preventing actions and reducing magic resistance. Qualifying damage wakes the target and adds capped bonus true damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lingering traps and bubble paths through terrain; use cleansing effects during drowsiness.

citations.quote: Active: Zoe kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit. At max range, it will linger as a trap for a few seconds that bursts upon enemy contact.

facts.claim: Zoe's bubble hits an enemy or lingers as a contact trap if it misses

citations.quote: The bubble can move through terrain only once, but travels the entire distance as bonus range

facts.claim: passing through terrain extends its range.

citations.quote: The burst deals magic damage and briefly inflicts drowsy, which gradually slows them. Afterwards, the target falls asleep for a short time, during which they cannot act.
While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced.

facts.claim: It deals magic damage and applies a growing slow followed by sleep, preventing actions and reducing magic resistance.

citations.quote: The next instance of non- persistent damage from champions, large monsters or turrets against the target, within 3.25 seconds of the sleep being applied, ends the sleep prematurely if it is active and deals bonus true damage equal to the post-mitigation damage dealt, capped at Sleepy Trouble Bubble's damage.

facts.claim: Qualifying damage wakes the target and adds capped bonus true damage.

cards.priority_reason: Her main setup spell disables targets and amplifies follow-up damage.

cards.answer: Zoe briefly blinks to a nearby position, then returns to her starting position. At the destination she cannot move normally, but can attack and cast spells outside brief action lockouts.
cards.counterplay: Watch her starting position and aim pressure at her return.

citations.quote: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.
Afterwards, she blinks back to her starting position.

facts.claim: Zoe briefly blinks to a nearby position, then returns to her starting position.

citations.quote: Zoe is able to perform any action while at the blink destination, except practically being unable to move through normal movement due to having 0 movement speed.
Zoe briefly becomes unable to act after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.

facts.claim: At the destination she cannot move normally, but can attack and cast spells outside brief action lockouts.

cards.priority_reason: The temporary reposition creates attack opportunities and a predictable return point.

cooldown_candidates.reason: A missed bubble creates an important pressure window; hitting an enemy champion refunds part of its cooldown.
Star availability determines the rhythm of her projectile pressure.
Portal Jump availability affects her temporary repositioning and return-point opportunities.
